questions.stem: A newborn was born to a pulmonary tuberculosis-positive lady at 38 weeks of gestation who was not on ATT. The newborn was given isoniazid-based therapy and the BCG vaccine at birth. What kind of example is the BCG bacillus Calmette-Guérin vaccine?
questions.solutionHtml:
Artificial active immunity
  • Artificial active immunity is the Immunity induced by vaccines. Vaccines are the preparation of live and killed microorganisms on their products used for immunization.


Ananthanaryan and Paniker Textbook of Microbiology, 12th Edition, Page No. 86

questions.stem: A 50-year-old woman has a chronic cough and on radiological examination, a cavitary lesion was seen in the apical area of her lungs. Her sputum is positive for acid-fast bacilli. Which of the following is the principal form of defence by which the patient’s body fights this infection?
questions.solutionHtml:
Cell-mediated immunity
  • The patient has pulmonary tuberculosis.
  • The principal host defence in mycobacterial infection is cell-mediated immunity, which causes the formation of granulomas.


Ananthanaryan and Paniker Textbook of Microbiology, 12th Edition, Page No. 80

questions.stem: Conventional smear microscopy with the Ziehl-Neelsen (ZN) stain is a rapid and practical method for detecting acid-fast bacilli (AFB), especially in low-income countries, due to its rapidity, low cost, and high positive predictive value for tuberculosis. Which of the following bacteria are acid-fast-
questions.solutionHtml:
Nocardia
  • Nocardia is acid-fast with 1% sulphuric acid (weakly acid-fast)


Ananthnarayan 12th Edition, Page No.14,15, Apurba S Sastry 3rd edition, Page No. 28, 29

Strict aerobe
  • Mycobacterium tuberculosis is an obligate pathogenic bacterial species in the family Mycobacteriaceae and the causative agent of tuberculosis.


Ananthnarayan 12th Edition, Page No. 417-425, Apurba S Sastry 3rd edition, Page No. 595-97
